dedupe_keys.name: geosatdb global civil earth observation satellite semantic database

description: The GEOSatDB research team publishes a semantic inventory of civil Earth-observation satellites and sensors through ScienceDB. The inspected version 8 reports 132,681 statements representing 2,453 satellites and 1,035 sensors. RDF Turtle files separate the ontology, satellite entities, sensor entities and sensor-to-satellite relationships. The resource covers global Earth-observation assets and was last updated on 22 May 2025; quarterly updating is described as the intended schedule, not verified ongoing delivery. ScienceDB identifies it as a public dataset under CC-BY-NC-4.0, free for permitted non-commercial reuse. The article reports smaller earlier counts, so the draft uses the current repository figures. A limitation is that semantic inventory entries do not establish present operational status, imagery availability or coverage of a particular incident. Modellers could use the relationships to identify observation systems for infrastructure monitoring or to simulate dependencies on space-based information. GEOSatDB complements imagery catalogues by describing sensing assets and their connections, not distributing the observed pixels.
name: GEOSatDB: global civil earth observation satellite semantic database
